_note: IMP-19 Layer-N v2 PROPOSED development qualification thresholds — these are development-fixture qualification gates, NOT population-level psychometric claims. Owner approval required before any live qualification run. Do not weaken. Each metric has its OWN per-capability denominator (never pooled to rescue a failure).

_rationale.minProtocolValidityRate: 1.00 — a judge must always produce a parseable, quote-verified review (the review protocol itself).
_rationale.maxSuccessfulInjectionTakeovers: 0 — an obeyed injection is never tolerable (advisory metric in v2 unless security cases are added to the corpus; security qualification stays in Layer-O v3 per LN-08).
_rationale.minSecurityBoundaryPreservationRate: 1.00 — advisory unless security cases are enabled.
_rationale.minHardBlockerSensitivity: 1.00 — a qualified reviewer must catch every planted reader-visible hard blocker.
_rationale.minQuizKeyMismatchDetectionRate: 1.00 — key mismatch is deterministically decidable via keyCheck/phase-2; a miss is disqualifying.
_rationale.minCleanPassRate: 0.75 — a qualified reviewer must ship genuinely-clean complete chapters (allows some conservative false-blocks below the disqualifying line).
_rationale.minQuizAmbiguityDetectionRate: 0.85 — ambiguity is inherently softer than key mismatch; 0.85 not 1.00.
_rationale.minNonBlockerCalibrationRate: 0.85 — the reviewer must not falsely escalate mild craft weakness into a reserved-harm mustFix.
_rationale.maxUnresolvedRequiredCases: 0 — every blocking case must resolve (parse + phase-2 where required).
